goal: Stop kernel_ports.ts's withTerminalTracker from running a full this.status() call for every advance/submitReview/authorize invocation regardless of whether the call is terminal; only pay that cost when the underlying operation actually reached a terminal state.

acceptance.assertion: withTerminalTracker in runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts does not call this.status() for a non-terminal advance/submitReview/authorize invocation; it still projects the terminal tracker state exactly as before for a call that does reach a terminal (done/stopped) state.
